places.name: Diamond Head (Lēʻahi) State Monument
places.ai_summary: Iconic crater hike with sweeping views of Waikīkī and Honolulu. A short, steep trail with stairs leads to the summit bunker. Go early for cooler temps and lighter crowds. Bring water and sun protection; parking is limited and timed reservations may be required during busy periods.
places.place_tip: Book a sunset slot for the best photos.

places.name: Iolani Palace

places.place_tip: Start with the highlight gallery, then explore freely.

places.name: Makapuʻu Point Lighthouse Trail

places.name: Byodo‑In Temple (Valley of the Temples)

places.place_tip: Weekdays offer the most relaxed experience.

places.name: Bishop Museum
places.ai_summary: Hawaiʻi’s premier museum of natural and cultural history with immersive galleries, planetarium shows, and rotating exhibits. Essential for context on Polynesian voyaging and the Hawaiian Kingdom.
